name: Der Future Science and Technology Holding Group Co., Ltd.
summary: Der Future Science & Technology Holding Group Co., Ltd. is a China-based company principally engaged in the research, development, production and sale of wood flooring, custom furniture, and density board products. The company's offerings include engineered wood flooring, solid wood flooring, custom wardrobes, and custom cabinets. Additionally, the company is involved in the graphene industry, including the development of graphene-related preparation equipment and application products.
